payload.corrects: The partial reading (celecoxib/albuterol/median1 far, qed nearly there) looked task-shaped because the complete broad set was missing. Adding jnk3 and perindopril_mpo -- both broad, both far -- breaks it.
payload.hypothesis_not_measured: INFERRED, not measured: the discriminator may be SIGNAL DENSITY along the path rather than target narrowness. isomers_c7h8n2o2 gained the largest lift (+0.8132) on a formula-matching objective that scores every step toward the target composition; gsk3b (+0.40) and jnk3 (+0.35) also climbed. Discriminating test: regress fraction-of-anchor on a measured path-gradient statistic, not on the narrow/broad label.
payload.information_regime_statement: Answer-known, panel-informed and winner-informed development evidence. Destinations are published task answers or transcribed competitor winners. Never a training distribution, prior, library or initialization for a scored no-prescreen run.
payload.load_bearing_for_the_controller: Test A: construction works (102/108 = 94.4% neutral transfers, exact recovery). Test B: exploitation works (64 calls from the anchor region reach 0.986/0.957/0.933/0.924 top-10). Test C: discovery does NOT -- 0/11 reach anchor. The gap is entry into the productive region, and it is not confined to narrow targets.
payload.question: Can blind no-prescreen search DISCOVER the productive regions that Test A proved constructible and Test B proved exploitable?

the_two_apparent_successes_both_deflate.perindopril_mpo: Blind lift over initialization is EXACTLY +0.0000 -- 250 charged calls did not improve on the 16 initialization molecules at all, yet it still lands at 38.4% of anchor.
the_two_apparent_successes_both_deflate.qed: Initialization alone was already 0.9016; 250 calls of blind search added +0.0399 to reach 0.9415. The task-independent init bank is median QED 0.763 with 85% at or above 0.6, so qed is substantially solved AT INITIALIZATION. Its 98.9% of anchor is not evidence that blind discovery works.

payload.verdict_statement: Neither branch of the sealed falsifier fires. Branch 1 required blind search to reach the ANCHOR rung: ZERO of 11 tasks reach anchor, so it is falsified outright. Branch 2 required blind search to top out near EARLY on rediscovery tasks while CLEARING ANCHOR on broad-objective tasks: no broad task clears anchor either, so it is not satisfied. The measured outcome is a third shape the prediction did not name, and is reported as such rather than rounded into branch 2.
payload.what_the_data_shows: The discovery gap is UNIVERSAL, not task-shaped. Broad jnk3 (38.2% of anchor) and perindopril_mpo (38.4%) sit with narrow celecoxib (37.2%) and thiothixene (37.1%); narrow isomers_c7h8n2o2 (90.0%) beats every broad task except qed. Median fraction-of-anchor is 44.6% narrow vs 52.8% broad -- heavily overlapping, so narrow-vs-broad does not explain the split.
